from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687629/attempts/1a23792c575c414fa559b68921d57662/system/state/workspace/programs/task-eaff7e50.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    if not grid:
        return []
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    solid_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    solid_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    for r in solid_rows:
        for c in range(w):
            out[r][c] = 2
    for c in solid_cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
''')
test=[[7,7,5,5,7,7,5,7],[7,7,5,5,5,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[5,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[7,5,5,5,7,5,7,5],[7,7,5,5,7,7,5,7],[7,7,5,5,5,7,7,7],[7,7,5,5,7,7,7,7],[5,5,5,5,5,5,5,5],[5,7,5,5,7,7,7,5],[7,7,5,5,7,5,7,7]]
